Sandbox_DoomedRoadkillPhysics_AnimalImpu: Scales the weight-derived reaction a vehicle receives from a live animal. 1.0 is the intended mass-based fix; 0 removes the vehicle kick; values above 1 remain capped at Build 42.20's original force.
Sandbox_DoomedRoadkillPhysics_ZombieImpu: Scales the targeted horizontal slowdown a vehicle receives from hitting a live zombie. 1.0 keeps Build 42.20's reaction, 0.5 halves it, and 0 removes that horizontal impulse. Zombie damage, sounds, and prone wheel lift are unchanged.
Sandbox_DoomedRoadkillPhysics_CorpseImpu: Scales the mass-derived wheel lift and torque a vehicle receives from a corpse. 1.0 is the intended mass-based fix; 0 removes corpse lift; values above 1 remain capped at Build 42.20's original force.
